title: On Windows the commit hooks cannot tell git commit --amend -F or -m, so commit-msg diffs against HEAD
goal: kg_hooks.amend_running tells a git commit --amend with -F, -m or -t among the hook's ancestors on Windows as it does on Linux and macOS (kg_hooks.parent_args gives no parent or command line there today), so the amend mark names HEAD's parent and commit-msg's KB-* trailers diff against it; test_commit_msg_amend_with_message_file_reads_the_parent checks the amend -F and -m cases on Windows too, and the hook's added cost per commit on the Windows host is measured and stated
